item.title: Java 21: The LTS Release That Changes Everything
item.description: Why Java 21 Is Different Every third Java release is an LTS — Long-Term Support. Java 21 is the fourth LTS after Java 8, 11, and 17. But unlike previous LTS releases, which were largely incremental, Java 21 delivers features that fundamentally change how you write concurrent code, how the JVM manages memory and GC, and how Java competes with dynamic languages for expressiveness. Three years of Project Loom work lands as Virtual Threads — production-ready, requiring zero framework changes for most Spring Boot or Jakarta EE applications.
